objs.name: document
objs.description: A controlled information object that is created, edited, reviewed, released and archived in the P&R Management system. Documents can be policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, or work instructions.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document type that documents locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A document type describing detailed work steps, test instructions, and compliance criteria for sub-processes.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: A document type describing the specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons to achieve an objective.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attachment that is subject to the release cycle of the main document and automatically released with the main document.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A document supplement that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and can be deleted directly.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A planned amendment to an existing document that can be created and managed without affecting the content or version history.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A system participant who can perform roles in document management and approval processes.

objs.name: author
objs.description: A user with write and change permissions who creates and edits documents.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: A user with write and change permissions on a document in addition to the registered author.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A user who checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A user who is responsible for a document and decides whether it is distributed to readers.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A user who can only view approved documents.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A user who can translate released content into another language.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned specific authorizations for documents.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to review whether a document should remain valid or be revised.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: An electronic signature recorded for workflow participants when they complete approval tasks.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A maintained list of User Groups and persons assigned to receive document distributions.

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined structure for documents of a specific type that can be selected when creating new documents.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: System metadata that can be automatically linked to documents including processes, organizational units, and risks.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: A company structure element that can be referenced in document properties.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk element that can be referenced and linked to documents.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: A system or application that can be referenced in document properties and linked to documents.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of a new information object with selection of document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modification of document content using the implemented editing client based on source format.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Setting standardized and customer-specific metadata and attributes of a document.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic system conversion of document to PDF format upon saving.

evts.name: initiate_release_process
evts.description: Start of the 3-step approval workflow consisting of Creator, Review, and Release steps.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronic signature completion by workflow participants during approval process.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Technical and formal checking of document content by assigned reviewers.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final approval and publication of document by assigned releaser.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication of document after release making it visible to readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Creation of a new editing version when a valid and released document is revised.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of attachments for archiving when no longer relevant in new document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of a planned amendment to an existing document by an author.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of a new document version when a Change Proposal is scheduled for implementation.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirmation that a document remains valid and updating of the Valid until date.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declaration of document as Out of Force and revocation of authorizations.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdrawal of authorizations for invalidated documents while retaining for archive group.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validation of a previously invalidated document and creation of new version.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Notification of assigned User Groups and persons when new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatic workflow request for active confirmation of document acknowledgement by recipients.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Active confirmation of acknowledgement by a user for a document version.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of released document content into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Technical and formal checking of translated document by assigned reviewers.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Final approval of translated document by assigned releaser.

evts.name: view_document
evts.description: Access and display of approved document by authorized reader.

o2o.description: A Document can be created based on one or more predefined Templates.
A Document can have attached controlled Attachments.
A Document can have supplementary Additional Info.
A Document can reference other Documents.
A Change Proposal belongs to and is displayed in a Document.
A Document can be automatically linked to Master Data elements.
A Document can reference and be linked to Organizational Units.
A Document can reference and be linked to Risks.
A Document can reference and be linked to IT Applications.
A Document maintains a Distribution List of User Groups and persons.
A Validity Extension Request is linked to a Document for review.
An Override Request is created for a Document to be invalidated.
A Reactivation Request references a previously invalidated Document.
An Author is a User with specific write permissions.
A Co-Author is a User with additional write permissions.
A Reviewer is a User assigned to check document content.
A Releaser is a User responsible for document approval.
A Reader is a User with view-only permissions.
A Translator is a User assigned to translate documents.
A User Group contains multiple Users assigned specific authorizations.
A User Group can be assigned to a Distribution List.
Signatures of workflow participants are documented for each released Document version.
An Attachment is controlled by and released with its main Document.
Additional Info is supplementary content to a Document.

A User performs the creation of a Document.
A Document has its content edited.
An Author performs editing of Document content.
A Document has its properties and metadata maintained.
A Document is automatically converted to PDF format.
A Document enters the release workflow process.
An Author or Co-Author initiates the release process for a Document.
A Document receives an electronic signature.
An Author signs in the Creator workflow step.
A Reviewer signs during the Review workflow step.
A Releaser signs during the Release workflow step.
A Document is reviewed for technical and formal aspects.
A Reviewer checks the Document content.
A Document is released and approved for publication.
A Releaser approves the release of a Document.
A Document is automatically published after release.
A Document is revised creating a new editing version.
An Author performs the revision of a released Document.
An Attachment is marked for archiving.
A Change Proposal is created for a Document.
An Author creates a Change Proposal for a Document.
A Document creates a new version when implementing a Change Proposal.
A Change Proposal is implemented in a new Document version.
A Document has its validity extended.
A Releaser confirms validity extension for a Document.
A Validity Extension Request is processed and deleted.
A Document is declared Out of Force.
A Releaser declares a Document as Out of Force.
An Override Request triggers invalidation of a Document.
A Document is archived with authorizations revoked.
A Document is reactivated from archive status.
A Reactivation Request triggers reactivation of a Document.
A Document version is distributed via email notification.
A User Group receives email notification of Document distribution.
A Reader receives email notification of Document distribution.
A Document requests active acknowledgement confirmation from recipients.
A User is requested to confirm acknowledgement of a Document.
A User confirms acknowledgement of a Document version.
A Document is translated into another language.
A Translator translates a released Document.
A Document translation is reviewed for accuracy.
A Reviewer checks the translated Document.
A Document translation is released and approved.
A Releaser approves the release of a Document translation.
A Document is accessed and displayed.
A Reader views an approved Document.
